mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies along the Military Ridge State Trail with an air quality index of 81. The waxing gibbous moon is out, and while the space station will pass overhead, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona has released the proposed 2027 budget, and the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th to review development projects including Ardent Glen, Jenna Drive, and a new site plan for Sub-Zero.

Today is packed with activities including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Macs, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on October 26th, trivia on October 27th, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory on October 28th.
The Verona Police Department reported that on October 15th, they arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle, which is a local favorite. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight.
